Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
Name: Whispers of the Chamber
Type: Reaction
Card Text:
Only usable during a  action against you (or a card you control).
Requires a vampire with at least 3 capacity.
This minion untaps and attempts to block with an optional press.
As above, with +1 intercept.

Art notes:
Perched gargoyle in the shadow seen from behind.
The gargoyle is obviously focussing on something.

World of Darkness reference:
Whispers of the Chamber is a minor Visceratika power, took some artistic liberty in game effect for VTES.

Created by: Ben Gerrissen

How does this card address a compelling game need?:
I feel Gargoyles should be masters of protecting their haven and kine, so this builds on the concept of "second tradition: Domain" and "Eyes of Argus", two cards unavailable to Gargoyles, but a right fit. The minimum requirement of 2 capacity is to make this card unavailable to Tupdogs, ommit it if you feel it's not a huge hit on balance. Perhaps boost intercept to +2, not sure, if considered, that could be tested during play testing.

Changes:
V2 - Changed wording:
Only usable during a  action directed at you, your minion(s) or your location(s)against you (or a card you control).
Requires a vampire with at least 23 capacity.

-1 Strength

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> GreyB wrote:
> Only usable during a  action directed at you, your minion(s) or your location(s).
>
An action that targets "you" includes all the cards you control.

I suppose that you want to restrict it so it doesn't work against a Path for instance, or a Constant Revolution, but it would work if someone wanted to look at your hand.

I don't think there's an easy wording for this, so I'd just stick to "a  action against you (or a card you control)", the part between parenthesis being a reminder.
